entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Battle of Praga or the Second Battle of Warsaw of 1794, also known in Russian and German as the Storming of Praga and in Polish as the Defence of Praga, was a successful Russian assault on Praga, the easternmost community of Warsaw, during the Kościuszko Uprising in 1794. It was followed by a massacre of the civilian population of Praga.
